title: Prove half-total odd-cycle rigidity and the sharp unequal-width C5 boundary
body:
PR5180 leaves open whether unequal-width odd-cycle optima must remain locally equivalent to integral edge/private channels. This package proves a universal boundary: over every field, every fitting matrix whose rank is half its total width is locally an edge-channel form with no private channels. The proof treats arbitrary directed rectangular neighbor blocks and every odd cycle of length at least five.

Over Q, the smallest positive unequal-width C5 counterexample has total width seven: widths (1,1,1,2,2), minimum rank four, and every cycle edge active. The all-field equality theorem rules out total six. Zero widths have a distinct smallest boundary, total three. The inherited minimum-rank formula is credited to JoyboyBrian's PR5023; the rigidity argument extends Nick Petalas's PR5180 and credits PR3248's earlier C5 result.

Registered normal and direct optimized checks pass. Source-history and official committed export integrity pass. Fresh Git-free isolated optimized replay passes; seven actual missing-input/source/typed-receipt/scientific mutations reject, with exact byte restoration. Subsequent commits add validation documentation and correct the explicit two-port local-gauge orientation only; cold science was run at e429af48b2af768cd084b1178b64246d71a8bb28 with identical executable/input/receipt bytes.

This is an algebraic normal-form and sharp-boundary theorem, not a physical decoder or multiplication bound. It does not classify all odd-total optima or all total-seven profiles. Complete proof, attribution, cost limitations and open next questions are in the package.

Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0 and predecessor attribution retained.
